Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time on last week's intro call. We'd like to run a technical briefing and kick off a short pilot to validate latency/cost for the workloads you described. Two options that usually map well depending on your calendar: a) a focused 30–45 minute exec briefing for the leadership team (architecture overview + ROI summary) or b) a 90-minute hands-on tech walkthrough with our infra engineer and a sample MAP for POC steps.

Proposed windows: week of Nov 29 or week of Dec 13. If neither works, we can slot something in early January.

I've attached the latest technical brief and a draft mutual action plan so you can see what a pilot looks like.

Attachments: Redwood_Technical_Brief_v3.pdf (pdf, 2.1 MB), Mutual_Action_Plan_NS-0841.xlsx (xlsx, 120 KB)

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the materials — the brief looks helpful. Quick heads up on timing: our CFO and VP of Product will be out a lot over the next three weeks for year-end travel and we are entering a short spend freeze while finance finalizes the FY reset. Practically speaking, that means we can't commit to any pilot start dates until after the budget gate closes, which should be around Dec 10–14.

If you have a condensed exec deck we could share with the leadership team this week, I can circulate it with Carlos and the CFO ahead of his travel; otherwise I think the earliest practical hands-on session will be the week of Dec 13 or, more likely, early January once the new baseline is in.

Also: procurement will want the MAP and any initial SSO/SCIM questions answered before kickoff — I'll share that with our security lead when they're back.

Thanks,
